scenarios.SCN-001: Owner at Main Restaurant on the dashboard: an ordinary trading day.
scenarios.SCN-002: Manager at Main: free tables get dine-in orders sent to the kitchen and some tickets start cooking. Check Tables, the Kitchen board and the Dashboard (sales ×2.2).
scenarios.SCN-003: Manager at Main on Low stock: Fish Rice & Curry and Egg Pastry are under their minimum, Vegetable Roti is out. Try selling one at the POS, or transfer stock in.
scenarios.SCN-004: Manager at Main on the prepared-item queue: food cancelled after the kitchen made it. Cancel a sent item on a table order to add another (resale / wastage / staff meal).
scenarios.SCN-005: Manager on Counter POS 1 at Shifts: two drawer shifts closed (one Rs 200 short) and one open. Close it with a count, then open the next with that float.
scenarios.SCN-006: Signed in as a Cashier on Reports, which the role can’t open: you get the 403 page, not a hidden menu. In POS, a void needs a manager PIN (2222); the cashier’s 3333 is refused.
scenarios.SCN-007: Cashier on Counter POS 1 with a paid sale from today. Open Sales history → Return on an invoice → pick items → refund → manager PIN 2222 → reason.
scenarios.SCN-008: Field sales rep in Van 1: today’s route and shops on credit. Lakshmi Stores is near its limit; Sea View Stores and Station Canteen are overdue.
scenarios.SCN-009: Manager at Main on the delivery board: phone orders at every stage, one out with Sameera for cash on delivery. Assign a rider and move them along.
